# Phase Transition Checklist

Use when attempting to move from current phase to next phase.

## Transition gates (all required)

- [ ] All current-phase PRD requirements implemented.
- [ ] Functional behavior verified end-to-end.
- [ ] Required tests/checks pass.
- [ ] No major regressions introduced.
- [ ] UI is responsive across required breakpoints.
- [ ] UI follows design system and interaction rules.
- [ ] Security requirements for current phase are satisfied.
- [ ] Existing functionality still works.
- [ ] Current phase Definition of Done satisfied.
- [ ] Phase verification template completed.
- [ ] Phase completion commit created with phase ID, PRD refs, and verification artifact path.

## Decision

- [ ] Approve transition
- [ ] Reject transition

If rejected, list blockers and keep current phase active.
